source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: Eleven adds across park districts (Clark County's Mill Creek, Springfield's Riverside), cities (Rushville, Macomb, Colona, Grayville, Monmouth, Rosiclare), a village (Riverton's Wheeland Park), the Effingham Water Authority's Lake Sara and Cook County Forest Preserves' Camp Bullfrog Lake. Excluded: Lake Mattoon (seasonal-only) and Lake Taylorville (seasonal-dominated), Shabbona Woods (tent), Pecatonica River FP (no campground). Kinkaid Lake's marina campgrounds held.

excluded.name: Lake Mattoon Campgrounds East & West
excluded.why: City of Mattoon: 'seasonal campground only' at both

excluded.name: Lake Taylorville
excluded.why: 95 permanent leased sites vs 12 overnight - seasonal-dominated

excluded.name: Camp Shabbona Woods (FPCC)
excluded.why: tent/cabin camp, no RV parking at sites

excluded.name: Pecatonica River Forest Preserve
excluded.why: Winnebago FP runs only three campgrounds (Sugar River, Seward Bluffs, Hononegah - all held); no campground here now

excluded.name: Du Quoin State Fair, La Porte-type fairgrounds, Scott AFB FamCamp, Hennepin Canal lock camps, youth/scout camps

held.name: Kinkaid Lake - Ed Bottoms / Glenn Seeber (Kinkaid Lake Villages marina)
held.why: marina concession on conservancy-district land; annual campsite leases dominate - check transient share before adding

other.name: (private gap)
other.why: ~60 private unmatched (Chain O'Lakes, Rock River, southern IL); IL holds only 34 private entries
